entries.title: UI Directory
entries.text: One live list of every screen, tab, dialog, settings interface, settings panel, plugin UI and banner across every app, read from the registries so nothing is typed in by hand. This tab shows how big it is, when it was last built, a Rebuild now button and the install and uninstall panel.

entries.title: Rebuild now
entries.text: Reads every registry again and rewrites the directory when anything moved. The change log keeps what was added, changed and removed. Builds do this by themselves; press it after a change you made by hand.

entries.title: Refresh
entries.text: Reads the current size and build time of the directory again without rebuilding it.

entries.title: Directory size
entries.text: How many rows the directory holds, per kind (screens, tabs, dialogs, settings, panels, plugin UIs, banners, apps) and per app, and when it was built.

entries.title: Rebuild
entries.text: Reads every registry again and redraws the directory with what moved. Builds do this by themselves.

entries.title: UI Directory page
entries.text: Every screen, tab, dialog, settings interface, panel, plugin UI and banner of every app as one tree: app, then plugin or shell, then screen, then its tabs, dialogs and panels. Search it, filter by app, kind, status or token family; a row's open button opens that UI, the gear opens its settings, the info button shows the four ways to reach it without the UI (MCP, REST, CLI, voice). Also: axf ui-directory show --q <words>, the MCP tool ui_directory_show, or say "open UI Directory" (a row: "open <its name>").

entries.title: Search
entries.text: Words every row must match, over its name, id, keywords, plugin and address. Groups open by themselves while you search.

entries.title: App
entries.text: Only the UIs of one app. Rows of another app show how to reach them there; only this console's rows open here.

entries.title: Kind
entries.text: Only one kind of UI: screens, tabs, dialogs, settings tabs, settings panels, plugin UIs, banners or apps.

entries.title: Status
entries.text: Live: reachable by a deep link. Dynamic: drawn at run time. No deep link: nothing opens it yet. Off: its plugin is switched off.

entries.title: Tokens
entries.text: Only UIs styled from one asset-token family (colour, type, spacing, radius, border and so on), read from their own code.
